newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London firmer in cautious trade.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London firmer in cautious trade.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London were slightly firmer in thin volume on Thursday as investors held off ahead of key U.S. data due to be released on Friday, dealers said.
"It's been a fairly quiet but firmer day with some follow-through buying on blue chips which have been moving up in Tokyo over the last couple of days," one trader said.
The Nikkei 50 index ended up 13.73 points, or 0.96 percent, from Wednesday's close at 1,450.51.
In Tokyo on Thursday the Nikkei 225-share index was little affected by Wall Street's recent falls and gained 92.01 points, or 0.51 percent, to 18,129.31.

Dealers said some investors were discouraged by a weaker dollar and were slightly nervous ahead of the U.S. nonfarm payrolls figures due out on Friday, which could raise expectations of a hike in U.S interest rates.
"People are very keen to see what the U.S. numbers suggest for Wall Street over the next week or so," one said.
They said there had been some profit-taking in blue chip shares and interest in pharmaceuticals as defensive stocks.
